# AgentDescent
> A parallel, asynchronous framework for self-evolving LLM agents. Diffs are the gradients; the aggregator is the optimizer.

Canonical: https://agentdescent.hugoxk.online/
Repository: https://github.com/ThinkFlowLab/agentdescent
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/agentdescent/
DeepWiki: https://deepwiki.com/ThinkFlowLab/agentdescent
DeepWiki MCP: https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
